text:
elaine: Heads up — onboarding guide has a 404 on the API quickstart anchor. Found it while helping a new hire. Link: https://docs.redwood.run/onboarding#api-quickstart -> 404. curl -I shows 404.

docbot: Automated link-checker: /onboarding#api-quickstart -> 404 (checked 2026-03-20T15:02Z). Report ID: lc-20260320-73.

jess: Who owns onboarding atm? @docs-team any idea?

yash: I last touched onboarding in Nov '25 when we reworked the TL;DR. Happy to take this one.

sam: If it's just an anchor rename we can do a tiny sed patch. Quick patch I would run locally:
```bash
sed -i 's/#api-quickstart/#api-quickstart-guide/g' docs/onboarding.md
git add docs/onboarding.md && git commit -m "fix: update onboarding anchor for api quickstart"
```
I'll include a tiny test tweak so CI doesn't choke.

elaine: :thumbsup: thanks Sam. If you open a PR ping me and I'll review. New hire blocked on the example right now.

luis: FWIW we should consider a shortlink/redirect from the old anchor to the new one so old permalinks don't rot. @docs-team any objection?

docs-team: No objection — we can add a mapping in shortlinks.json and deploy with the next docs release. Tell us the final anchor path and we'll schedule it. ETA: by EOD tomorrow.

sam: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123 — sed change + updated test. CI passed locally, waiting on remote CI.

elaine: Nice. @docbot can you re-run the link-check once PR is merged? Would like to confirm the 404 is resolved.

docbot: Re-scan queued post-merge (will post results in this thread).

yash: I'm claiming ownership for onboarding for now and will add myself to CODEOWNERS for docs/onboarding.md in a follow-up PR.

luis: :eyes: I'll keep an eye on the redirect deployment; can help if docs-team wants me to push it.

jess: Great coordination — adding this to the weekly docs triage board so we don't miss follow-ups.

(ends)
